snippet.title: Journey to the Void - Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Are you ready to set on your expedition to the heart of the continent?
After years of hard work, balancing, and bug fixing, we’re honored to announce that Journey to the Void is finally launching on Steam on January 28, 2026. 

We know how much you loved our demo, and we can’t wait to hear your feedback on the full game. Did you think that two biomes and dozens of cards and enemies were enough to challenge your strategic thinking? You’ll be happy to hear that it was only the beginning! Far greater dangers and far more fearsome foes await you on your expedition into the Void. On January 28, you’ll finally experience our full vision of what the combat system is capable of, and we couldn’t be more excited!

Journey to the Void wouldn’t exist without the love and support you’ve shown us over the years. And of course, it wouldn’t exist without the passion and dedication of our amazing team. This game is a true labor of love, and our greatest achievement will be seeing you enjoy it. On January 28, our journey will finally begin!
